Why do I see offline mode?

Offline mode appears when the app can\'t reach the server. Common causes: no internet, weak signal, or the system put the app to sleep. Previously saved messages and avatars work offline, but new messages will send once the connection is back. Check your internet, and if it keeps happening, go to Troubleshooting and disable battery optimization.

First check that notifications are enabled. Other common causes are battery optimization (the system puts the app to sleep in the background), Data Saver and missing permission for exact alarms. Troubleshooting checks all of these and shows a fix button next to each problem.

This is usually caused by battery optimization — phone makers (Xiaomi, Samsung, Oppo) aggressively sleep background apps. Go to Troubleshooting and disable battery optimization for SinusChat. This is the single most important thing for receiving messages quickly.
How does adding by NFC work?

The person who wants to share their contact opens the Add (+) tab. The other person stays on the home screen. Put the phones back-to-back (NFC antennas are usually in the upper part of the back) and the contact transfers automatically — just like scanning a QR code. Both phones must have NFC enabled.
The QR scanner won\'t start the camera
The first time, the app asks for camera access — you need to grant it. If you declined before, go to phone Settings → Apps → SinusChat → Permissions → Camera → Allow. Then the scanner will work.

A profile photo works offline only if it was loaded earlier while you had internet — the app caches it then. On the first online contact the photo downloads, and after that it shows even without a network. If someone was never loaded online, you\'ll see a colored letter instead of a photo.

You\'ll find the setting in the contact\'s or group\'s profile, under \"Disappearing messages\". In a private chat the other person gets a request in the chat, and messages start disappearing once they accept. In a group the change applies to everyone right away. Only messages sent after turning it on disappear, and the timer starts when a message is read — separately for you and the other person.

Key verification lets you confirm you\'re talking to the right person and nobody is impersonating in the middle. In the contact\'s profile, choose \"Verify keys\" and compare the safety code with the other person — by phone or in person. Matching codes = the conversation is secure.
How do I turn Sinia (AI) on or off?

Go to Settings → Additional features → AI mode and confirm the change. The app briefly restarts to add or hide the Sinia tab. Downloaded models take a few GB — when AI mode is off, you can delete them there.
How do I delete my account?
Settings → Account → Delete account. Your account is deleted after 14 days — until then you can cancel. Your profile, group memberships and problem reports are deleted with it.
Where are photos and files from chats?
In the app\'s private folder — they don\'t appear in your phone\'s gallery. See how much space they use and in which chats in Settings → Device storage. You can also clear the cache there.
Where will I see the reply to my report?
In Report a problem → Your reports. You\'ll get a notification when we reply or change the status. A report disappears 30 days after its last change.
